name: web
description: Player front-end (lobby, baccarat, dragon-tiger, poker) served by Next.js

scripts.build:legacy: npm run build:legacy:lobby && npm run build:legacy:baccarat && npm run build:legacy:dragon-tiger && npm run build:legacy:poker
scripts.build:legacy:baccarat: npm --prefix legacy-build/games ci --no-audit --no-fund && node legacy-build/games/build.mjs baccarat
scripts.build:legacy:dragon-tiger: npm --prefix legacy-build/games ci --no-audit --no-fund && node legacy-build/games/build.mjs dragon-tiger
